# truenas_nvmet_global (Resource)

Manages the TrueNAS global NVMe-oF target configuration. This is a singleton resource — there is exactly one NVMe-oF global configuration per TrueNAS system, so it is never created or deleted on TrueNAS; Terraform create/update calls nvmet.global.update, and Terraform delete only removes the resource from state (the configuration is left in place, since it serves live storage).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_nvmet_global" "config" {
  rdma = false
  ana  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ana` (Boolean) Whether Asymmetric Namespace Access (ANA) is enabled.
- `basenqn` (String) Base NVMe Qualified Name (NQN) prefix used when generating subsystem NQNs.
- `kernel` (Boolean) Whether the kernel-mode NVMe-oF target implementation is used.
- `rdma` (Boolean) Whether NVMe-oF RDMA transport is enabled.
- `xport_referral` (Boolean) Whether transport referral is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton resource: always "nvmet_global".
